summary: Produced WP-007-recommendation.md evaluating all three options (conditional mcpServers, new template variant, accept limitation) against constraint 21, build-script impact, user experience, and maintenance burden. Recommendation: implement Option 1 — derive mcpServers from the existing tools list's server-name prefixes. No build-script changes made (investigation-only WP).

comments.note: Key insight from the investigation: the persona's tools list already encodes the MCP server name (e.g., 'central_pm/*' → server = 'central_pm'). Option 1 exploits this to derive mcpServers automatically, requiring zero new YAML fields and zero new templates. This is strictly better than Option 2 (which adds a has_mcp flag and a new convention) and the UX is strictly better than Option 3 (which leaves CC users without working MCP access). Recommended: implement Option 1 in a follow-up work package.

comments.note: No blocking issues. Structured evaluation tables with identical criteria rows make comparisons easy.
